description: Checks a cartoon, with the studio's own checks, before anyone sees it. Give one of cartoon, program, pack, character or file. Returns errors (it will not play as written: also a character or background the site lacks) and warnings, each {code, where, says, fix, url}, with did_you_mean and an RFC 6902 patch when certain; issues a viewer would see (off stage, overlapping, an empty stage, a line cut off) with a summary of who is where and says what when (seconds; x as a share of the stage); and, when ok, the canonical program and a link. repair: true also returns the program with every certain patch applied. Nothing you send is kept. Example: list_characters' cartoon_example.

cartoon.description: A cartoon: its program, a cartoon file {cast, program}, a project file, or its screenplay text (read only on your own computer).

character.description: Your own character, {"name", "content"}, or a character pack.

file.description: On your own computer only: a .json or .txt file's name in the output folder.

pack.description: A whole pack: its manifest and its content.

program.description: A move (get_move gives ready-made ones) or a scene program.

repair.description: true: also return repaired: the program with every certain patch applied, and the changes.

name: validate
title: Check a Jabbertoon cartoon, scene, move, pack or character
